question: What scores, native tie behavior and resident-query costs do the pinned released GPUSparse paths produce on the shared capped integer input?
hypothesis: All native top-k score sequences and returned-passage scores match the independent integer oracle under the exact FP32 domain bound; canonical numeric-ID ties may differ. Relative cost of native monolithic/chunked/compacted paths remains empirical.
representation: Shared uint8 impacts and cap32 integer queries converted exactly to float32; every nonnegative score bound255*sumweights must be<=2^24. This is not original-model float-native quality reproduction.
index: CPU GSP CSR to sorted CSC conversion; all original numeric IDs retained and mapped on output. One disclosed stride cast compatibility repair; score/selector algorithms unchanged.

correctness.runtime_negative_test: Wrong expectedBLOCKPL must reject before any query computation and before output files.
correctness.unsupported: Requestedk0 rejected uniformly: pinned compacted multichunk source indexes the zero-width runningthreshold. Positive requestedk with empty corpus remains tested.
correctness.rule: All score sequences, actual returned-passage integer scores, position range/uniqueness and counts pass. Canonical ID disagreements are retained as native tie audit, not silently corrected.

timing.post_timing_validation: Every returned passage score checked against direct integer CSR scoring after all query timers finish.
timing.boundary: CPU query padding, query H2D copies, complete released native function, result D2H copies, original numeric-ID mapping and synchronization.
timing.excluded: Index conversion/load/upload and native chunk-boundary construction; runtime gate; independent CPU score validation; file I/O.
timing.primary: AtBLOCKPL512, query-wise median wall latency ratios of chunked/compacted to monolithic, equal weighting over500queries and3processes.
timing.sensitivity: Full128 series retained as shipped-default sensitivity. No causal acrossBLOCKPL conclusion from unbalanced three-series block order.
timing.uncertainty: 10000 crossed query/process bootstrap draws, seed20261111; conditional calibration only.
timing.rationale: Pinned README reports512 strongest in its own priorstudy, while128 is the APIdefault. Both are measured here; its published magnitude is not transferred to our capped workload.
timing.stopping: All correctness before timing; fixed processes/rounds, no optional stopping or tuning on heldout. Defer if target remains occupied10minutes.

environment: Prepared isolated Python3.12/torch2.6.0+cu126/triton3.2.0/numpy2.2.6/scipy1.15.3 compatibility environment; actual imports/device info observed and runtime-gated.
provenance: Exact local code commit before compute, native Git/source hashes, environment/wheel metadata, original outputs and actual post-run JIT artifact hashes/bytes preserved. Native internal compiler defaults pinned to library version and source; no guessed custom launch settings. Original and effective native source hashes plus patch hash/ID are runtime-gated. The prepared dependency repository stays unchanged; a fresh private clone is patched.
limits: No canonical tie guarantee, no direct primary-U64 contract speedup claim or policy waiver.
Allocator peak since postsetup reset includes resident index/querybuffers but excludes setuptransients, context/driver/non-Torch allocations.
Calibration only; no heldout or service-tail claim.
No new CIMS retrieval before separate code/CPU/config and launch-driver review.

compatibility_patch.delta: Remove scalar out_stride.to(tl.int64); q_idx is already int64 and promotes multiplication. No score/selector/tie/query/layout parameter changes.
compatibility_patch.application: git apply --unidiff-zero; original and effective file hashes checked

retry_policy: Up to three reviewed repair/rerun attempts before publication; stop on complete success. Fresh run directories; retain original failure. User-authorized correction on current unpublished experiment branch.
